No wait, the ball is already gray... hmm, the ball is now the white diamond at (59,27), and the gray diamond is at (47,17). - Square→gray: Δ(12,10), length ≈ 15.62

Or: the square moved to the midpoint of the ball and the gray diamond, and the ball moved to the square's old position. Let me verify: the midpoint of (36,7) and (59,27) = (47.5, 17) ≈ (47,17) or (48,17). The square moved to (53,22), not (47.5,17). So no.

Hmm, what if clicking the square rotates the line? Let me test: click the square (now at (53,22)) and see if the line rotates or just compresses.
Actually, let me think about the colors more. The ring is made of p (purple) dots. The ball's center is p. The square's center is M (magenta). The gray diamond's center is p.
